title: Decide whether this resource server may trust the token
description: Change claims, clock tolerance, key state, replay policy, and attack condition. The lab applies one explicit access-token profile and shows every accept, reject, or replay warning.

issuers.label: Configured issuer
issuers.detail: Exact case-sensitive match to the issuer configured by the resource server.

issuers.label: Foreign issuer
issuers.detail: A different issuer that may have its own valid keys but is not trusted here.

audiences.label: Orders API
audiences.detail: The resource server evaluating this token.

audiences.label: Profile API
audiences.detail: A valid audience for another resource server, not this one.

timeStates.label: Active for 5 minutes
timeStates.detail: The token is already active and expires in 300 seconds.

timeStates.label: Expired 45 seconds ago
timeStates.detail: A tolerance of more than 45 seconds would still admit this token.

timeStates.label: Not active for 90 seconds
timeStates.detail: The nbf claim places the token 90 seconds in the verifier's future.

keyStates.label: Active issuer key
keyStates.detail: The kid resolves to a currently published key bound to the configured issuer.

keyStates.label: Old key still published
keyStates.detail: The key no longer signs new tokens but remains trusted during planned overlap.

keyStates.label: Unknown or removed kid
keyStates.detail: The verifier cannot find the kid in its trusted cached or refreshed key set.

keyStates.label: Key from another issuer
keyStates.detail: A real public key that is not bound to the configured issuer.

attackConditions.label: Ordinary signed token
attackConditions.detail: A complete RS256 JWS using the expected access-token type.

attackConditions.label: alg=none
attackConditions.detail: An unsecured token asks the API to skip the signature.

attackConditions.label: HS256 / RS256 confusion
attackConditions.detail: The token switches from the configured asymmetric algorithm to a MAC algorithm.

attackConditions.label: Wrong JWT type
attackConditions.detail: A signed JWT from another protocol context is presented as an access token.

attackConditions.label: Attacker-controlled key URL
attackConditions.detail: The protected header points at a key source that the recipient never configured.

attackConditions.label: Copied token replay
attackConditions.detail: A previously observed, otherwise valid bearer token is presented again.

replayPolicies.label: Ordinary bearer
replayPolicies.detail: No per-request replay state; possession is enough until expiry or revocation.

replayPolicies.label: One-time jti
replayPolicies.detail: This endpoint atomically records the token ID and rejects a second use.
